phases.source: Web: Brent 77->116 USD; Hormuz closed; ~10.7mbd lost by Mar 20; peak Mar 30
phases.defining_characteristic: Pre-ceasefire active conflict; Iran strikes back; Hormuz disruption; major supply shock
phases.key_events: Feb 28 US-Israel attacks begin; Mar 5 3.6mbd lost; Mar 18 South Pars strike; Mar 30 Brent peak $116 plus Houthi entry

phases.source: Web: Iran-Israel ceasefire Apr 7; OPEC+ monthly meetings Mar-May; de-escalation with sub-phases
phases.defining_characteristic: Ceasefire holds; tanker traffic resumes partially; no active large strikes; OPEC+ production hikes monthly 411kbd/mo; market normalizing
phases.key_events: Apr 7 ceasefire announced; May 31 8th OPEC+ meeting; mixed naval/tanker posture; Project Freedom preparations

phases.source: Web: Operation Rising Lion Jun 13 (1-day IST/EDT offset); Israel preemptive strike; US joined
phases.defining_characteristic: Short sharp spike window: anticipatory strikes; missile retaliation; tanker attacks begin
phases.key_events: Jun 9-12 tensions escalate; Jun 13 IL preemptive strikes; US B-2s hit nuclear sites; Iranian missile retaliation; tanker attacks in Hormuz begin

phases.source: Web: partial Hormuz disruption reported; ~12 tankers interdicted since early Jun
phases.defining_characteristic: Brief naval blockade pause or partial transit restoration between major strike waves; lower-confidence period
phases.key_events: Strait flow reduced; insurance pricing spike; SPR releases begin; transitory pause in kinetic action

phases.source: Web: continued tanker interdictions; mine-laying near Khor Fakkan approach; Brent climbing toward $148
phases.defining_characteristic: Sustained low-intensity escalation; mine-laying near Hormuz approach; insurance rates up ~4000%; SPR releases from US/JP/DE/FR/KR; Brent steadily climbing
phases.key_events: Continued IRGC Navy tanker strikes (~12 total Jun-early Jul); insurance market withdrawal thresholds approached; naval buildup in Gulf of Oman

phases.source: Web: Ceasefire collapse Jul 8; US-Iran direct strikes resume; Hormuz central battlefield
phases.defining_characteristic: Ceasefire framework breaks; US-Iran direct strikes resume; Hormuz becomes central battlefield
phases.key_events: Jul 8 ceasefire collapse; US-Iran direct strikes resume; Hormuz central battlefield

phases.source: Web: Repeated US strike waves; Iranian retaliation; commercial shipping attacks; renewed US blockade
phases.defining_characteristic: Sustained major re-escalation; Hormuz war; open warfare
phases.key_events: Repeated US strike waves; Iranian retaliation; attacks on commercial shipping; renewed US blockade

phases.source: Web: US strikes pause ~two weeks; Oman-mediated talks progress; Hormuz dispute unresolved
phases.defining_characteristic: Operational pause; renewed diplomacy; Oman-mediated talks progress
phases.key_events: US strikes pause; Oman-mediated talks progress; Hormuz dispute unresolved

phases.source: Web: Iranian attack on US forces during pause; threat of major US response; diplomacy deteriorates
phases.defining_characteristic: Ceasefire/pause breakdown; renewed escalation; Iranian attack on US forces
phases.key_events: Iranian attack on US forces during pause; threat of major US response; diplomacy deteriorates

phases.source: Web: Second de-escalation; strike cancellation; negotiation attempt; Trump cancels planned major attack; renewed diplomatic effort over nuclear + Hormuz
phases.defining_characteristic: Second de-escalation; strike cancellation; negotiation attempt; Hormuz deal formation
phases.key_events: Trump cancels planned major attack; renewed diplomatic effort over nuclear issue + Hormuz; possible deal to be announced

cross_factor_highlights.lead_lag_summary: No significant lead-lag at daily or window level between Brent and WTI
cross_factor_highlights.eia_wed_effect: Wednesday EIA days show systematically lower (or more negative) returns in war-regime phases
cross_factor_highlights.weekly_structure: Monday positive bias (+1.5% WTI, +1.66% Brent), Friday negative bias (-0.43% WTI)
